short_reading.title: A Bad Day
short_reading.text: Tom is upset today. He loses his new pen at school. His friend Ben is helpful and looks for it. They find the pen, and Tom smiles again.

short_reading.title: My Little Brother
short_reading.text: My little brother is silly and funny. He makes us laugh every day. But he is sometimes stubborn, and he cries at night. I give him a hug, and he is calm.
